seriesName: Kioxia-Sandisk Japan investment: planned future spend vs. historical spend

points.label: Invested in Japan over past 25 years

notes: Both figures are lower-bound ('over') numbers stated in the same Kioxia/Sandisk August 27, 2026 press release: over $50 billion invested in Japan over the past 25 years, versus over $31 billion planned through 2032 (contingent on government support). Useful context for the bullet's point that this new money is spread over roughly 6-7 years, not an immediate injection -- it is on the same order of magnitude as a quarter-century of prior spending, underscoring that relief, if it comes, arrives slowly. Both numbers came from the same single page, so the one-source rule is satisfied. Could not find a verifiable, non-hedged, single-source year-by-year capex breakdown or NAND price series that would support a longer point list; industry price-forecast figures found elsewhere (TrendForce, etc.) were hedged forecasts and/or from a banned publisher, so they were excluded per the rules.
